spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_reversion_tail_liquidity_altbasket
spec.hypothesis: Short-window taker buy/sell volume imbalance reversion (frozen definition from sprint22/23, the higher-hit-rate of the two taker_imbalance variants) closes the last untested cell in the 5-signal x 3-universe matrix by applying it to the tail-liquidity/delisted altbasket, where 4 other signals already failed at consistent ~-25 to -36bps net despite near-zero gross alpha -- testing whether cost structure alone explains that pattern.
spec.power_argument: Comparable taker_imbalance-reversion runs (sprint22 n=475, sprint23 n=1520) imply per-trade SD~28bps; at floor n=300, MDE(t=2)~3.2bps, well below T2 all-in cost (~11-13bps), so a deployable edge would be detected. Expected realized n on this basket ~500-1500 based on sprint21/23/26/31/32/34 analogues, exceeding the 300 floor.

params.definition: frozen, identical to sprint22/23 registered taker_imbalance-reversion threshold
